scripts.build: npm run data && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts/*.mjs *.ts *.json index.html README.md docs/AI_DEVELOPMENT_LOG.md docs/DEMO_SCRIPT.md docs/VALIDATION.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests scripts/*.mjs *.ts *.json index.html README.md docs/AI_DEVELOPMENT_LOG.md docs/DEMO_SCRIPT.md docs/VALIDATION.md
scripts.build:portable: npm run build && node scripts/build-portable.mjs && python scripts/package-portable.py
scripts.build:windows: npm run build:portable && node scripts/build-windows.mjs && python scripts/package-portable.py
